title: Beach Boys Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Nestled in the charming neighborhood of Old Seagrove, this exceptional custom home is a true testament to craftsmanship and design. It spans an impressive four levels, featuring five spacious bedrooms.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: ▪️ Newly built, custom and professionally decorated designer home, FIRST time on the rental market SUMMER 2024! ▪️ 6 Seater Golf Cart (Included with signed waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit) ▪️ Private pool with optional heat (additional charge to heat the pool) ▪️ 4 KING suites featuring private en-suite designer baths, TVs with cable and streaming capabilities ▪️ Bunk room with large sitting area and TV ▪️ Elevator servicing all floors (residential elevator, not wheelchair accessible) ▪️ 2 Beach cruiser bikes ▪️ Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals ▪️ Sandpiper linen participant ▪️ Fully stocked kitchen complete with Keurig and standard drip coffee maker ▪️ One block (3 min walk) to 2 beach access locations! ▪️ Maximum 2 cars only allowed OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: → Vacation Cancellation Protection → Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($200 fee applies at booking) → Pool heat Nov-April. This charge is $50/day → Golf Cart- use the golf cart with a signed liability waiver and $1000 refundable security deposit! Nestled in the charming neighborhood of Old Seagrove, this exceptional custom home is a true testament to craftsmanship and design. It spans an impressive four levels, featuring five spacious bedrooms, each thoughtfully equipped with its own ensuite bathroom. Evening gulf views from the top-floor tower complete a wonderful day. As you step into the foyer and enter the main level of this exquisite home, you are immediately immersed in the artistry of custom trim and millwork, meticulously crafted from rare black cypress found rarely in homes here on 30a. Throughout the residence, six-inch white oak plank flooring creates a timeless backdrop, seamlessly connecting all of the living spaces. The heart of the home is found in the kitchen with 4 designer bar stools, living and dining space (accommodates 8) and the transition from indoor to outdoor living is effortlessly achieved with floor-to-ceiling NanaWalls. The gourmet kitchen boasts top-of-the-line amenities and custom pecky cypress cabinetry accented with elegant glass inlays. For effortless entertaining, a well-appointed wet bar is positioned off the kitchen. Convenience is key on the first level, which also features a mudroom with direct access to a second courtyard, complete with a summer kitchen and a gas fireplace. The primary suite features cathedral-style ceilings crafted entirely from cypress. The spa-like ensuite bathroom showcases Carrara marble floors and showers, a theme that is echoed throughout all of the home's bathrooms. The second level offers a private balcony and three additional bedrooms, each accompanied by its own ensuite bath, ensuring comfort and privacy for guests. A second wet bar, additional laundry space and a cozy sitting room enhance this floor's conveniences. The third floor presents the ultimate children's suite, beginning with bunk beds crafted from black cypress. This floor also features its own elegant bathroom suite with double vanities and an oversized shower. The fourth-floor tower sits above the canopy of Old Seagrove, offering panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico. This level is designed for enjoyment with a well-appointed wet bar, complete with a wine refrigerator, making it effortless to entertain family and friends while relishing in the splendor of Gulf Coast sunsets. ACCOMMODATIONS: First Floor: ✦ King Master Suite; en-suite with walk-in shower & separate bathtub, TV Second Floor: ✦ King Master Suite; en-suite bath walk-in shower, TV ✦ King Master Suite; en-suite bath walk-in shower , TV ✦ King Master Suite; en-suite bath walk-in shower , TV Third Floor: ✦ Bonus Room with sofa- 2 sets of built-in bunk beds (enough room to sleep 4) with hall bath walk-in shower FREE WIFI **Please note only 2 cars are allowed at this home** **No parties** **This home requires guest booking be at least 25 years of age** **No pets, sorry!**

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
